**Interpreting Element Relationships**

I'm now investigating the relationship between the teal (8), red (2), and grey (5) elements, specifically their heights across columns. I'm focusing on the hypothesis that the difference in height between 8 and 2 dictates the presence and height of 5. For example, when 8 has height 2 and 2 has height 4, there is no 5 because 2>8. The hypothesis seems correct!

I've made a breakthrough. I am now focused on calculating the difference between the total height of 8s and 2s in each example. It looks like the resulting height of the grey (5) element is the absolute difference. Also, the column of 5 might be related to the column of 8!
